claims: 4 is the natural number following 3 and preceding 5.
The 4 cardinal points are North, South, East, West.
4 is the second square number after 1.
4 is the only integer where the number of letters in its English name "four" equals its value.
In East Asian cultures, 4 is considered unlucky due to phonetic similarities with the word "death".
Many East Asian cultures avoid the number 4 due to tetrophobia.
4 is represented by the Roman numeral IV.
4 is represented by the Roman numeral IIII
